title: Karlsberg Quest walk route (content/routes/<id>.json)
description: Editor support only. Generated by scripts/content-build/routes.mjs from scripts/content-build/routes/<id>.spec.json over public/data/paths.json; do not edit by hand. Consecutive points are 3–30 m apart, every stop lies within 3 m of the polyline and the stops are in route order (tests/routes.test.ts). Design: docs/design/tour/systems.md §3.

slots.description: Hand-staged standing places of the group at this stop: [x, z] each.

glades.description: Circles [x, z, r] near the stop that stay free of forest-floor props (ferns, bushes) today, so what the stop is about can be seen from the path. r ≤ 12 m, centre ≤ 60 m from the stop.
